title: Length of the Selected Word
statement: Let $m$ and $w$ be binary words of equal length. The length of the word selected from $w$ along $m$ is the number of entries of $m$ equal to $1$.
replaced: For every mask $m$ and every choice word $w$ with $|w| = |m|$, the word selected from $w$ along $m$ has length equal to the number of $1$ entries of $m$.
